page_title: UDI 1-1 VER | Udinese v Verona 25/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+3' Rafik Belghali (Verona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
88' Oumar Solet (Udinese) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
88' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Paride Tremolada had a clear view and blows his whistle.
85' Enzo Ebosse (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

83' A great pass puts Hassane Kamara (Udinese) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
82' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) replacing Fallou Cham.
82' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Suat Serdar (Verona) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Enzo Ebosse.
82' The game is interrupted as Rafik Belghali (Verona) is flagged offside.
81' One of the Udinese players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
79' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Jordan Zemura will be replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
78' 10:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) comes onto the pitch for Keinan Davis.
73' 1 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Suat Serdar (Verona) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Giovane knock down. 1:1.
72' Verona have a corner.
72' Fallou Cham (Verona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Rafik Belghali (Verona) is replacing Domagoj Bradaric.
70' Keinan Davis (Udinese) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
67' The referee blows his whistle as Arthur Atta (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
66' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Amin Sarr is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
66' Substitution. Abdou Harroui (Verona) has come on for Cheikh Niasse.
64' Fallou Cham (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Razvan Sava comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.

63' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a brilliant save! The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
61' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) replaces Iker Bravo.
61' It's time for a substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on in place of Sandi Lovric.
61' One of the players from Udinese times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
59' Amin Sarr (Verona) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
59' Lorenzo Montipo displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Keinan Davis (Udinese) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
58' Paride Tremolada has a clear sight and sees a foul from Amin Sarr (Verona).
57' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post.
55' Arthur Atta (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
53' 1 - 0 Sandi Lovric takes over corner duties and expertly finds Thomas Kristensen (Udinese), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header low into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:0.
52' Udinese win a corner.
52' Keinan Davis (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
51' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Giovane (Verona). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.

50' A sweet pass finds Giovane (Verona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Razvan Sava is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
48' Martin Frese (Verona) surprisingly hits a direct free kick goalwards from long distance, but the effort goes wide of the post.
47' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle and signals a foul after Arthur Atta (Udinese) brought his opponent down.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Paride Tremolada has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Keinan Davis (Udinese) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
44' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
41' Giovane (Verona) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Razvan Sava.
40' Antoine Bernede (Verona) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
37' Keinan Davis (Udinese) rises high to meet a cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and powers his header on goal, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes a save.
36' A pass by Jordan Zemura (Udinese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
33' Iker Bravo (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paride Tremolada had an easy-decision to make.
33' Total attempts – 3:1.
31' Fallou Cham (Verona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
30' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.

28' Unai Nunez (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Paride Tremolada with no other option than to blow for a foul.

27' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo was alert and the score remains the same.
24' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it.

22' Lorenzo Montipo doesn't have to worry about this one. Keinan Davis plays a pass into the feet of Jordan Zemura (Udinese), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
21' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Udinese have a corner.
19' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
19' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Udinese get a corner.
18' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
18' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Unai Nunez (Verona) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

16' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Lorenzo Montipo!
15' Razvan Sava displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Amin Sarr (Verona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
14' The ball is cleared after Jordan Zemura (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' The percentage of ball possession is – 63:37.
8' Giovane (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
4' Unai Nunez (Verona) brings his opponent down. Paride Tremolada has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Verona will kick-off.
Paride Tremolada will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
